# Countdown Timer API v3 — operations

6 operations. Full request and response shapes: [reference.md](reference.md).

- `countdown-timer.create-countdown-timer` — **Create Countdown Timer** — `POST /countdown-timer/timers` (write, location)
  Create a countdown timer for the access token's location
- `countdown-timer.delete-countdown-timer` — **Delete Countdown Timer** — `DELETE /countdown-timer/timers/{timerId}` (write, location)
  Soft-delete a countdown timer
- `countdown-timer.get-countdown-timer` — **Get Countdown Timer** — `GET /countdown-timer/timers/{timerId}` (read, location)
  Get a countdown timer by ID
- `countdown-timer.list-countdown-timer-templates` — **List Timer Templates** — `GET /countdown-timer/templates` (read, location)
  Get the available countdown timer templates with their default design configuration
- `countdown-timer.list-countdown-timers` — **List Countdown Timers** — `GET /countdown-timer/timers` (read, location)
  Get a paginated list of the countdown timers belonging to the access token's location
- `countdown-timer.update-countdown-timer` — **Update Countdown Timer** — `PATCH /countdown-timer/timers/{timerId}` (write, location)
  Update an existing countdown timer
